name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.0-dev.38 (18 Nov): new start screen (night flag-raising key art with the FREEDOM ARROW title, mouse parallax), Freedom Arrow loading screens replace every vanilla one (24 pictures: China, US, Russia), China voices regenerated with a word-for-word check and 10 selection/move/attack lines per unit, China 122 mm rounds use the howitzer explosion, FA Music 1.5.4 hides the music panel outside the main menu. Includes 0.9.0-dev.37. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.46.
